description: Regulatory source manifest. Place permitted source PDFs in this folder using the exact file name. Verification status and reuse notes are recorded per source; not every source URL or redistribution right has been verified.
gdpr_scope_note: CORRECTED 2026-10-20: GDPR is NOT in the corpus. No GDPR text file exists in this project and no rule cites GDPR articles. Early project documents named GDPR as a source; it is recorded in this manifest as a missing source (see the GDPR entry). The previous wording of this note, which implied GDPR articles are used for compliance reasoning, was inaccurate.
